name: marker
description: The marker CSS property points to a marker that will be drawn on the first, middle, and last vertices of the element's path; that is, at all of its vertices. The marker must have been defined using an SVG 'marker' element, and can only be referenced with a "urlvalue", "<url>" value. The value of the CSS property overrides any values of the marker-start, marker, and marker-end attributes in the SVG.
